info.title: Architecture Diagram Service API
info.description: This API provides functionalities for managing and retrieving architecture diagrams. It includes endpoints for creating, updating, deleting, and fetching diagrams, as well as managing related metadata. The API ensures secure access and efficient handling of architecture diagram data.

post.summary: Retrieves TOSCA mapping and returns a response.
post.description:
This method retrieves TOSCA mapping using the KbToscaApplicationService
and returns a response with the TOSCA mapping.

get.summary: Retrieves master diagram templates and returns a response.
get.description:
This method retrieves master diagram templates using the MasterADTemplateApplicationService
and returns a response with the retrieved templates.

get.summary: Retrieves the architecture diagram (AD) associated with a specific project.
get.description:
This method handles GET requests to retrieve the architecture diagram for a project. It
requires authentication and the 'permission_model' permission. The project ID should be
provided in the request parameters under the key 'project_id'.

post.summary: Creates a new blank architecture diagram (AD) for a project.
post.description:
This method requires authentication and the 'project_diagram.create' permission. It creates
a new blank AD for a project based on the provided data, which should include the project
ID. The method returns a success response with the newly created AD.

patch.summary: Updates the architecture diagram (AD) of a project.
patch.description:
This method requires authentication and the 'project_diagram.update' permission. It updates
the AD of a project based on the provided data, which should include the project ID and the
new canvas. The method returns a success response with the updated AD.

get.summary: Retrieves CACTi JSON for a specific project from the database.
get.description:
This method retrieves a project ID from the request data, verifies the project ID using the
provided AuthenticationProducer, and retrieves the CACTi JSON for the specified project from
the database using the cacti_service.

post.summary: Add new CACTI output to the database.
post.description:
This method creates a new CACTI output for a project based on the provided CACTI output
dict, which should include the project ID. The method returns a success response with the
newly created CACTI json.

delete.summary: Deletes CACTi file for a specific project from the database.
delete.description:
This method retrieves a project ID from the request data, verifies the project ID using the
provided AuthenticationProducer, and deletes the CACTi file for the specified project from
the project AD file store.

get.summary: Retrieves module files for a specific project from the database.
get.description:
This method retrieves a project ID from the request data, verifies the project ID using the
provided AuthenticationProducer, and retrieves the module files for the specified project
from the database using the file_module_service.

post.summary: Uploads a module directory to the database.
post.description:
This method retrieves a project ID, directory name, and zip file from the request data,
verifies the project ID using the provided AuthenticationProducer, and uploads the zip file
to the database as a module directory.

delete.summary: Deletes module files for a specific project from the database.
delete.description:
This method retrieves a project ID from the request data, verifies the project ID using the
provided AuthenticationProducer, and deletes the module files for the specified project from
the database using the file_module_service.

get.summary: Retrieves Terraform files for a specific project from the database.
get.description:
This method retrieves a project ID from the request data, verifies the project ID using the
provided AuthenticationProducer, and retrieves the Terraform files for the specified project
from the database using the file_terraform_service.

post.summary: Uploads Terraform files to the database.
post.description:
This method retrieves a project ID and a list of files from the request data, verifies the
project ID using the provided AuthenticationProducer, and uploads the Terraform files to the
database using the file_terraform_service.

delete.summary: Deletes Terraform files for a specific project from the database.
delete.description:
This method retrieves a project ID from the request data, verifies the project ID using the
provided AuthenticationProducer, and deletes the Terraform files for the specified project
from the database using the file_terraform_service.

post.summary: Create a new architecture diagram (AD) for a project from CACTi files.
post.description:
It creates a new AD for a project based on the provided data and the parsed CACTi files,
which should include the project ID. The method returns a success response with the newly
created AD.

post.summary: Creates a new architecture diagram (AD) for a project from terraform files.
post.description:
This method requires authentication and the 'project_diagram.create' permission. It creates
a new AD for a project based on the provided data and the parsed terraform files, which
should include the project ID. The method returns a success response with the newly created
AD.

post.summary: Creates a new architecture diagram (AD) for a project from a template.
post.description:
This method requires authentication and the 'project_diagram.create' permission. It creates
a new AD for a project based on the provided data and a specified template, which should
include the project ID and the template ID. The method returns a success response with the
newly created AD.

Generate a new TOSCA report for each canvas view in the diagram specified in the request.
The report will describe which relationships WARN or FAIL, and the reasons for each outcome.
